answer: The design leans on per-identity stake bond plus peer re-execution of every receipt. Every claim climbs the whisper of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the beacon re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a mathematical clarity, compound sentences linking proof generation to verification register, it stays short. The nebula of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
